title: Westhampton Free Library
summary: On This Site by Shinnecock artist Jeremy Dennis will be on view November 1–30, 2026. More exhibition information will be shared soon.

why_this_matters: Seeing On This Site at a local library connects contemporary Shinnecock art with places just beyond its doors: Potunk, Apocock and Quantuck. The exhibition offers a starting point for learning whose histories the surrounding landscape holds, and for continuing that exploration after leaving the gallery.
introduction_content: On This Site by Shinnecock artist Jeremy Dennis will be on view at Westhampton Free Library from November 1 through November 30, 2026. More information about the exhibition and related programs will be shared soon. On This Site at Westhampton Free Library — artist announcement
history_title: A library within a living Native landscape
history_content:
The library offers a place to connect contemporary Shinnecock art with the nearby histories of Potunk, Apocock and Quantuck. The exhibition invites visitors to continue learning about these places beyond the gallery.

Westhampton Free Library was founded on March 1, 1897. Its current building opened on June 26, 2010. Westhampton Free Library — Library History
whereintheworld_content: The art-show icon marks the public library at 7 Library Avenue, Westhampton Beach. Exhibition dates describe the run of the show, not daily opening hours. Check current library hours before visiting. Westhampton Free Library mapped building
